title: Children inherit the fanin bound
statement: Let $g$ be an internal gate of a Boolean circuit on $n$ variables — either an AND gate or an OR gate — applied to a list of child circuits, and suppose its maximum fanin is at most $w$. Then every child circuit occurring in that list also has maximum fanin at most $w$.
hypotheses_covered: the circuit is an internal gate (AND or OR) applied to a list of children
c is one of those children
the gate's maximum fanin is at most w
replaced:
If a node circuit $\mathrm{node}\,\mathit{isAnd}\,cs$ has maximum fan-in at most $w$, then
every child $c \in cs$ has maximum fan-in at most $w$.
